user.title: Select your scale
user.description: Step on the scale first — it only advertises while awake.

profile.title: Body profile
profile.description: The scale computes body fat, water, muscle and the rest on-device from this profile, so these values decide whether those readings are meaningful. Weight is unaffected. Use the same profile slot you normally weigh under on the scale itself.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up
abort.no_devices_found: No scale found. Step on it to wake it up, then try again.

init.title: Body profile
init.description: Changing this reconnects the scale so it recomputes with the new profile.
